change_interpretations.engineering_summary: The requirement now mandates that the software build identifier and the calibration version are recorded alongside timestamped mode changes. This is an additive change to the logging scope. Verification must ensure that the new field (calibration version) is correctly captured and stored in the log entries for mode changes. Existing tests that only check for the presence of a log entry or the build ID may need to be updated to verify the new field.
